messages:
ash: Quick tie-out from the PM: we've got 4 lingering remediation tasks that need owners, clear ETAs, and recurrence notes before I close the loop. can folks pick owners now?

mohit: list please

ash: A) prefix-eviction debounce (causing token-latency spikes) B) batch-queue alert consolidation (noise from dup alerts) C) canary rollback automation and gated playbook D) customer comms + postmortem summary for affected tenants.

clare: I can own D (customer comms + summary). will draft the customer note and timeline. ETA 2026-04-04.

samir: I'll take B (alert consolidation). will run a week of alert-snooze experiments and open INF-4104. ETA baseline + PR 2026-04-06.

mohit: I can pick A (prefix-eviction debounce). need to instrument eviction metrics and add unit tests. filing INF-4102. ETA spike + PR 2026-04-08.

devops-bot: Created INF-4102 (Prefix eviction debounce), INF-4104 (Alert consolidation), INF-4105 (Canary rollback automation) and assigned to mohIt, samir, and ash respectively.

ash: I'll own C (canary rollback automation) but need runtime pairing and a gated toggle for rollout. filing INF-4105. ETA prototype by 2026-04-09.

clare: proposed RACI: A: R=mohit, A=ops-lead, C=eng-runtime, I=oncall; B: R=samir, A=monitoring-lead, C=observability, I=customers; C: R=ash, A=ops-lead, C=security/runtime, I=platform; D: R=clare, A=ps-lead, C=solutions, I=customers.

ash: recurrence note: eviction spikes seen 3x in last 9 weeks during stress tests and 1 customer replay. please tag tickets with "recurrence: eviction-thrash" and paste short timeline.

mohit: will attach eviction traces, t=2026-03-21 and t=2026-03-30, and a short replicate script to INF-4102.

samir: will attach alert histograms and sample pages to INF-4104.

ash: backups: backup owners - A: samir, B: clare, C: mohIt, D: ash.

ops-lead: I'll book a 20-min check-in Thurs 11:00 to confirm PRs are progressing and to clear cross-team blockers.

clare: INF-4103 is a doc stub I created for the PM summary (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4103). will fill by 2026-04-04.

ash: please set the JIRA remediation ETA field and link PRs->PM doc. reply here with ticket numbers + ETAs. i'll escalate any missing ETAs by EOD Fri.

mohit: INF-4102 ETA 2026-04-08.

samir: INF-4104 ETA 2026-04-06.

ash: INF-4105 ETA 2026-04-09.

clare: INF-4103 ETA 2026-04-04. PRs and doc links to follow.

ops-lead: Thanks team. leaving thread open until all tickets show In Progress on the remediation board. ping if blockers appear. :white_check_mark:
